name: APNG and Animated WebP Converter

seo.title: APNG and Animated WebP Converter — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Decode APNG or animated WebP locally and convert bounded animations to GIF with explicit colour/timing limitations.

assumptions: The browser ImageDecoder API is preferred where available, with a local APNG decoder fallback.
limitations: GIF is limited to indexed colour and can be much larger or lower quality than APNG/WebP.
